Run Z3 static verification without building.

Performs formal verification of logical constraints in the project using the Z3 SMT solver. This catches logical errors that would be impossible to detect through testing alone.

Needs the full build (the `verification` feature).

# Example

```bash largo verify ```

Usage: largo verify [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo verify
